accuracyFlags: FAQ 'banned from ... all kiwi habitat' and 'always on a lead' on conservation land - overstated; DOC allows dogs at some campsites/tracks, and app data shows 74 of 287 DOC campsites allow dogs in some form.
'A single dog off a lead has killed multiple kiwi in a night' - unsourced; cite DOC.
'Pets generally not allowed at DOC camps ... without written approval' vs 'Some campsites expressly allow dogs' - fine but cite DOC pets page and date.
Dog restraint-in-vehicle/ute statement is stated as rule without a cited law (Animal Welfare / Land Transport rules); verify wording.
